rule_or_requirement: Latest user asks stronger acceleration; preserve original benchmark and evaluate complete lap times.
observable_information: Rendered pixels/HUD, previous road-center observations and own actions only. No simulator state.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four independent pixel contact/crossing mechanisms: impact classification override, propulsion release, side persistence, predictive crossing.
expected_success_endpoint: Preserve or exceed current10/12 completion, lap time tiebreaker, no promotion without ZIP and broader validation
control: Unchanged historical preview_row_repair and current arrival_speed references
falsifier: No actual action change, lower completion, slower tie, invalid actions or reference mismatch
